title: Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this hydrogen hardware application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by liquid hydrogen cryogenic flange bolt (grade 23) and specific design requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for hydrogen hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding all positions with 0.5mm corner radius
DPI dye penetrant inspect with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for liquid hydrogen cryogenic application
inspection: UT volumetric full matrix (liquid hydrogen verified)
commonFailures: Thermal ratcheting under cyclic temperature - controlled by stress-relief anneal 675C 2h Ar below beta-transus — critical for liquid hydrogen cryogenic performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt suitable for Liquid hydrogen cryogenic flange bolt (Grade 23)?
faq.a: Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address hydrogen hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for liquid hydrogen cryogenic requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. liquid hydrogen cryogenic components require Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for liquid hydrogen cryogenic application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Cryogenic H2 Flange Bolt includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet liquid hydrogen cryogenic specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for LH2 bolt / Cryogenic bolt hydrogen hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
